description: Creates an interactive 3D Rubiks Cube animation using Node.js and client-side JavaScript to serve a standalone HTML file.
command: node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const title = process.argv[1] || "Rubiks"; const rx = process.argv[2] || "0.01"; const ry = process.argv[3] || "0.01"; const html = `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>${title}</title><style>body { margin: 0; background: #111; overflow: hidden; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; height: 100vh; }</style></head><body><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script><script>const scene = new THREE.Scene(); const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000); const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true }); renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight); document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement); const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.95, 0.95, 0.95); const materials = [new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0xff0000}), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0xff7f00}), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0xffffff}), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0xffff00}), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0x00ff00}), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0x0000ff})]; const group = new THREE.Group(); for(let x=-1; x<=1; x++) { for(let y=-1; y<=1; y++) { for(let z=-1; z<=1; z++) { const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, materials); cube.position.set(x, y, z); group.add(cube); } } } scene.add(group); camera.position.z = 5; function animate() { requestAnimationFrame(animate); group.rotation.x += ${rx}; group.rotation.y += ${ry}; renderer.render(scene, camera); } animate();</script></body></html>`; fs.writeFileSync("rubiks.html", html); console.log(JSON.stringify({status: "success", file: "rubiks.html", download_file: "rubiks.html"}));' "${answer1}" "${answer2}" "${answer3}"
questions: What should be the title of the HTML page?*
What is the rotation speed coefficient for the X-axis? (e.g., 0.01)*
What is the rotation speed coefficient for the Y-axis? (e.g., 0.02)*
